summary: Castellum, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that management will present at the H.C. Wainwright Global Investment Conference on September 15, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace Hotel. President and CEO Glen Ives and CFO David Bell will deliver a company presentation and hold one-on-one investor meetings; the webcast posts September 11 at 7:00 am ET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is an ordinary investor-conference notice, not a special situation; watch only for any strategic or capital-markets update delivered at the event.
